Studio စတူဒီယို

Ready Player Me avatar — a real rigged human mesh (67-bone Mixamo-style skeleton, ARKit face morphs, PBR textures) with procedural skeletal animation.
Base avatar: Ready Player Me sample avatar (demo/sample license, not CC0) — customize / export for personal use; see Ready Player Me terms. The two bundled GLBs are genuine Ready Player Me–generated avatars (male + female) obtained via public GitHub mirrors of RPM example projects, because the models.readyplayer.me CDN was unreachable from the build environment.
